2. The crow flew here and there ____________ water.

3. ____________ her illness, she came to class yesterday.

4. Please cast your vote ____________ our candidate.

5. I earned this money ____________ my normal salary.

Try and make sentences with 5 other prepositions from the list.

Read the following sentences and mark the underlined nouns and prepositions after them:

I have no affection for him.

He has no ambition for fame.

Show allegiance to your master.

Pay attention to my speech.

He made a comment on my lecture.

Make a comparison between the two girls.

They have no compassion for the poor.

I have no connection with that man.

He has no desire for fame.

There is no exception to this rule

You should have sufficient exposure to English.

He expressed his gratitude to his boss.

I had an interview with the reporter.

Industry is the key to success.

He has a reputation for eloquence.
